what: Observation: the steward's fixes queued last night (allow read-only filters for producers, show policy denials to the error review, stop unreadable background commands, retry the shared build folder with its goal unchanged, fix study claim c45, run clippy before verification) sit at places 364 to 374 of a 203-item plan. At about 20 dispatches a day they will not run for weeks, while requests from late October run first. The one-in-three improvement turn reaches only a few older Athena items.
why: Athena now diagnoses well and queues the right fixes, but the queue order buries them behind hundreds of stale October requests, so nothing it learns is acted on soon. Reporting for the steward and the planner; not reordering by hand.
